ANN (Deep MLP).why_it_performs: Loses 2D spatial context due to 1D flattening. Massive 38.5M parameters lead to overfitting.

RNN (BiLSTM).why_it_performs: Sequential row scanning suffers from vanishing gradients across 224 steps and cannot capture diagonal/local 2D spatial features.

Custom 2D-CNN.why_it_performs: 4 Residual Stages with skip connections [F(x)+x] and 2x2 spatial pooling; achieves 87.38% test accuracy from scratch.

Pretrained ResNet18.why_it_performs: Deep residual connections + 1.28M ImageNet visual priors enable high-level neoplasm boundary recognition (94.56%).
